title: Invisible Universe
topic: particle physics for a teen audience, told as a journey from everyday matter down into the quantum world
summary: A detective-adventure journey from the everyday world down into quarks, leptons, forces, and the open mysteries of the quantum universe.

concepts.title: Meet the Proton, Neutron and Electron
CERN and the Large Hadron Collider
Could YOU Discover the Next Particle?

images.prompt: A breathtaking editorial illustration for a teen science book cover: a curious young explorer with a small glowing spherical AI companion, standing at the edge where an ordinary starlit bedroom dissolves into a cutaway journey down through molecules, atoms, and glowing subatomic particles arranged like a spiral nebula. Deep indigo night-sky palette with a single luminous cyan-blue accent light, glowing constellation-like particle trails, sense of wonder and scale, flat-modern editorial illustration style, no text or logos baked in. Target size ~1024x1365px, 3:4 portrait; compose for a book cover, subject centred with safe margins on all sides since it is letterboxed into a 3:4 box.
images.alt: A young explorer and a small glowing AI guide standing at the edge of a journey from the ordinary world down into the glowing world of subatomic particles
images.caption: Mira and Nova, on the edge of the smallest journey imaginable.

images.prompt: An evocative illustration of the Higgs field: a vast, faintly glowing indigo field of light stretching to the horizon, with a few glowing particles moving through it, some leaving barely a ripple, one heavy golden particle dragging a visible wake of light behind it to show it interacting strongly with the field. Deep-space observatory palette (indigo, glowing blue accent, warm gold as the one contrasting highlight), no text baked in, awe-inspiring and scientific, flat-modern editorial illustration style. Target size ~1280x720px, 16:9 landscape; compose for a small on-page figure, subject centred with safe margins since it is letterboxed into a 16:9 box.
images.alt: Particles moving through a glowing field, one dragging a heavier wake of light to show strong interaction with the field
images.caption: Different particles interact with the Higgs field by different amounts — that difference in "drag" is what we experience as different masses.

Deep indigo night-sky palette, one warm accent color reserved only for the antimatter side, flat-modern editorial illustration style, no text baked in.
